title: مأوى

ai_content.intro: استمتع بمشاهدة فيلم مأوى (2026) مترجم بجودة عالية على توميتو.

ai_content.desc_en: Shelter is an action-packed thriller film about a man in self-imposed exile on a remote island. When he rescues a young girl from a violent storm, he is forced to leave his seclusion and protect her from enemies connected to his past. "Shelter" is an intense and gripping adventure.
